marketplace.name: ccmaf-skills
marketplace.description: CCMAF Skills — production-grade, vendor-neutral skills for Claude Code and compatible agent runtimes, packaged as role/section packs plus an all-in-one plugin.

allInOne.name: ccmaf-skills
allInOne.title: CCMAF Skills (all-in-one)
allInOne.description: Every CCMAF skill as one plugin — senior-level engineering standards across languages, frameworks, cloud and operations, data, AI/agents, security and identity, plus agent-workflow and prose-quality disciplines. Prefer the role packs if you want a smaller skill listing.

packs.title: Core
packs.description: The agent-workflow disciplines every session benefits from: de-slopped prose, technical writing, docs-grounding, usage-limit hygiene, model calibration, systematic debugging, reviewable plans and recaps, committable diagrams, and the two shells.

packs.title: Engineering
packs.audience: Every developer, whatever the stack — install alongside core.
packs.description: The cross-cutting engineering disciplines: code review, secure development, test engineering, git workflow, architecture review, legacy modernisation, and Python as the general-purpose glue language.

packs.title: Web & UI
packs.audience: Frontend and full-stack developers building user interfaces.
packs.description: Building web UIs that look chosen and behave well: HTML/CSS/Tailwind craft, React and Next.js, TypeScript, design taste, UX reasoning, accessibility, render-and-critique verification, and web performance.

packs.title: Backend & APIs
packs.audience: Backend and full-stack developers building services and data access.
packs.description: Services and the contracts between them: HTTP and GraphQL API design, .NET, Go and Rust, relational SQL, identity and auth, and event-driven architecture.

packs.title: Infrastructure & Operations
packs.audience: Platform, DevOps and SRE engineers, and anyone who ships to production.
packs.description: Running software in production: Azure, Terraform/OpenTofu, containers and Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, observability, incident response, and Linux as both workstation and server.

packs.title: Microsoft Business Platforms
packs.audience: Developers and makers on Power Platform, Dynamics 365, Microsoft 365 and Fabric.
packs.description: The Microsoft business-application stack: Power Apps and Automate, Power Pages, Dynamics 365/Dataverse pro-code, Copilot Studio, Microsoft 365 development, Fabric, Power BI, and Sentinel/KQL.

packs.title: AI & Machine Learning
packs.audience: Engineers building on LLMs or training their own models.
packs.description: Software built on models: LLM applications and agents on the Claude API, retrieval-augmented generation as an engineered component, and classic/deep machine learning you train yourself.

packs.title: Data
packs.audience: Data engineers and anyone moving or analysing data.
packs.description: Moving and shaping data: vendor-neutral batch and streaming pipelines, ELT/dbt, orchestration, lakehouse modelling, data quality and contracts.

packs.title: Desktop & Mobile Apps
packs.audience: Developers shipping desktop or mobile applications.
packs.description: Native and cross-platform apps: Electron, Tauri, native Windows UI (WPF/WinUI/WinForms/MAUI), Android with Kotlin and Compose, and iOS with Swift and SwiftUI.

packs.title: Games & 3D
packs.description: Games and interactive 3D: Godot (engine, shaders, MCP-driven workflow), Unity, Unreal Engine 5, three.js, and the engine-agnostic craft of game feel.

packs.title: Creative & Media
packs.audience: Artists, technical artists and video makers working with code.
packs.description: Code-driven creative tooling: Blender scripting and pipelines, ComfyUI image-generation workflows, and programmatic video with Remotion.

packs.title: Research
packs.audience: Researchers, students and anyone who needs citation-safe sources.
packs.description: Scholarly research done carefully: literature discovery, source appraisal, evidence synthesis and citation-safe referencing.

packs.title: Automation
packs.audience: Anyone automating the web or repetitive work.
packs.description: Automating the web and repetitive work responsibly: scrapers and crawlers with a legal/ethical gate first.

uncanny.summary: Remove AI tells from prose so it reads as human-written, without swapping in a different costume.

technical-writing.summary: READMEs, ADRs, runbooks, changelogs and design docs on the Diátaxis framework, with every sample verified.

read-the-damn-docs.summary: Ground claims in version-matched official docs and installed source, not training memory.

stay-within-limits.summary: Keep long-running or parallel agent work inside usage limits: budget, checkpoint, stop on a soft threshold.

opus-5-calibration.summary: Operate Claude Opus 5 well: set the length dials, drop backfiring double-checks, keep empirical verification.

systematic-debugging.summary: Reproduce, minimise, bisect, test one falsifiable hypothesis at a time, fix the root cause, add a regression test.

visual-plan.summary: A grounded, reviewable Markdown implementation plan with diagrams and an open-questions gate, before any code.

visual-recap.summary: A high-altitude before/after recap of a completed change, true by construction from the real diff.

drawio-development.summary: Native, committable .drawio XML: well-formedness, layout discipline, export, and a render-check loop.

bash-development.summary: Production shell scripting: strict mode, quoting, ShellCheck, injection and temp-file safety, portability, BATS.

powershell-development.summary: PowerShell 7+: advanced functions, the pipeline, error handling, Pester, PSScriptAnalyzer and the security stack.

code-review-development.summary: Senior-level code review against one bar — the change improves codebase health — with a severity rubric.

secure-development.summary: OWASP Top 10 and ASVS reviews, STRIDE threat modelling, secrets and crypto hygiene, supply-chain security.

testing-development.summary: Test strategy above the unit level: Playwright E2E, load testing with SLO gates, contract testing, test data.

git-workflow.summary: Branching and commit hygiene, rebase vs merge, history surgery, conflicts, bisect, worktrees, disaster recovery.

architecture-review.summary: Review architecture on its own terms: quality-attribute trade-offs, one-way doors, failure modes, ADR quality.

legacy-modernisation.summary: Change code you don't fully understand safely: characterisation tests, seams, strangler fig, codemods, rollback.

python-development.summary: Modern Python 3.11+: idioms, the type system, asyncio, errors and logging, pyproject/pytest, performance.

frontend-development.summary: HTML, CSS and Tailwind v4 craft: design tokens, theming, semantic markup, distinctive design, a11y baseline.

react-development.summary: React and Next.js: render and data-fetching performance, composition, Server Components, the App Router.

typescript-development.summary: TypeScript 5.x type safety: generics, eliminating any, Zod, Node backends, tsconfig and tsc error-fixing.

design-taste.summary: Remove AI tells from visual design so a UI reads as chosen, not generated; register-aware polish.

ux-design.summary: Interaction and perception reasoning for any UI: Laws of UX, Gestalt hierarchy, affordances, forms, ergonomics.

accessibility-development.summary: WCAG 2.2 AA with the EU statutory frame: ARIA, keyboard and focus, accessible forms, testing, audit checklist.

ui-verification.summary: Render, view, critique, iterate: screenshot a UI at real viewports and critique the image, not the code.

web-performance-development.summary: Core Web Vitals, the critical rendering path, loading and caching strategy, service workers, budgets.

api-development.summary: HTTP API design: REST semantics, OpenAPI-first contracts, versioning, pagination, problem+json, webhooks.

dotnet-development.summary: Modern .NET and C#: ASP.NET Core APIs, EF Core, nullable reference types, testing, observability, performance.

go-development.summary: Modern Go: errors as values, goroutine/channel/context discipline, generics, modules, table-driven tests.

rust-development.summary: Rust 2024: type-driven API design, ownership and lifetimes, error and lint discipline, async/tokio, serde.

sql-development.summary: T-SQL and PostgreSQL: schema design, workload-aware indexing, query tuning, transactions, safe migrations.

identity-development.summary: Auth engineering: OAuth 2.1/OIDC flow selection, tokens, sessions, MFA and passkeys, SSO, RBAC/ABAC/ReBAC.

event-driven-development.summary: Delivery semantics, idempotent consumers, outbox, sagas, event sourcing/CQRS, dead letters, schema evolution.

graphql-development.summary: GraphQL end to end: SDL design, resolvers and DataLoader, mutations and errors, federation, security, caching.

azure-development.summary: Azure service selection and engineering: Bicep/Terraform and azd, compute, Entra ID, Key Vault, operations.

terraform-development.summary: Terraform and OpenTofu: module design, remote state, the plan-review gate, drift, environments, OIDC, testing.

containers-development.summary: Multi-stage Dockerfiles, compose for local dev, image and runtime security, registries, container hosting.

kubernetes-development.summary: Platform Kubernetes: workloads, autoscaling, networking, RBAC and Pod Security, storage, Helm, GitOps, AKS.

devops-development.summary: CI/CD on Azure DevOps and GitHub Actions: pipeline YAML, templates, OIDC, environments, pipeline security.

observability-development.summary: Correlated logs, metrics and traces with OpenTelemetry, the Collector, cardinality control, SLO burn alerts.

incident-response.summary: Run production incidents mitigate-first: severity, incident command, status cadence, blameless postmortems.

linux-development.summary: Linux as a workstation: filesystem and process models, permissions, the shell, packages, WSL2 in depth.

linux-administration.summary: Operating Linux servers: hardened systemd units, networking, users/sudo/PAM, performance, logging, automation.

power-platform-development.summary: Canvas apps and Power Fx, Power Automate flows, maker-side Dataverse, environments, solutions and ALM.

power-pages-development.summary: Power Pages: Liquid, the portal Web API, table permissions and web roles, SPA code sites, pac pages ALM.

dynamics-365-development.summary: Dynamics 365 / Dataverse pro-code: plug-ins and the pipeline, client scripting, PCF, Web API/SDK, ALM.

copilot-studio-development.summary: Copilot Studio agents, YAML-first: topics and actions, generative orchestration, knowledge, channels, ALM.

m365-development.summary: Microsoft 365 for developers: Graph and its SDKs, SPFx, Teams apps, SharePoint data access, Office add-ins.

fabric-development.summary: Microsoft Fabric: OneLake, lakehouse/medallion, Spark and Delta, ingestion, Direct Lake, capacity admin.

power-bi-development.summary: Power BI: star-schema semantic models, RLS, DAX and its performance, Power Query folding, TMDL/PBIP, ALM.

sentinel-development.summary: Microsoft Sentinel SIEM/SOAR and KQL: detections, ingestion cost, hunting, playbooks, MITRE ATT&CK mapping.

llm-development.summary: Software on LLMs: the Claude API, tool use and agent loops, prompts as code, caching, MCP servers, evals.

rag-development.summary: RAG as an engineered component: chunking, embeddings, hybrid retrieval and re-ranking, citations, evaluation.

machine-learning-development.summary: ML you train yourself: framing and baselines, leakage-safe splits, features, tuning, evaluation, production.

data-engineering-development.summary: Batch and streaming pipelines, ELT/dbt, orchestration, Spark, lakehouse modelling, data quality and contracts.

electron-development.summary: Electron: main/preload/renderer, secure IPC via contextBridge, native modules, packaging, signing, updates.

tauri-development.summary: Tauri v2 desktop and mobile: Rust-frontend IPC, the capability security model, plugins, builds, signing.

windows-desktop-development.summary: Native Windows UI across WPF, WinUI 3, WinForms and MAUI: XAML, MVVM, threading, packaging, UI Automation.

android-development.summary: Kotlin and Jetpack Compose: MVVM with unidirectional data flow, offline-first Room, Hilt, Gradle, testing.

ios-development.summary: Swift and SwiftUI: concurrency, MVVM, Human Interface Guidelines and accessibility, persistence, App Store.

godot-development.summary: Godot 4.x: typed GDScript and C#, scene composition, custom Resources, Jolt physics, headless CI exports.

godot-mcp-workflow.summary: Drive Godot and Blender from an agent over MCP: the edit-run-debug loop, tool limits, the glTF pipeline.

godot-shaders-development.summary: Godot 4.x shaders: the shading language, spatial/2D/particle shaders, compute GLSL, visual shaders, performance.

unity-development.summary: Unity 6: lifecycle and serialization, ScriptableObjects, prefabs and scenes, Addressables, Input System, DOTS.

unreal-engine-development.summary: Unreal Engine 5: Blueprints vs C++, the gameplay framework, reflection and GC, Nanite/Lumen, packaging.

threejs-development.summary: three.js and React Three Fiber: colour-correct scenes, the glTF pipeline, performance, shaders, pmndrs.

game-feel.summary: Make motion feel good in any engine: responsive input, coyote time and buffering, physics tuning, juice.

blender-development.summary: Blender bpy scripting, add-ons and extensions, Geometry Nodes, the engine export pipeline, headless automation.

comfyui-development.summary: ComfyUI: the graph model, UI vs API JSON, pipelines, custom nodes, the HTTP/WebSocket API, the RCE surface.

remotion-development.summary: Programmatic video with Remotion: compositions, frame-driven animation, sequencing, assets, rendering paths.

academic-research.summary: Citation-safe scholarly research: discovery via free APIs, appraisal, evidence synthesis, reviewer simulation.

web-scraping-development.summary: Responsible scrapers: the legal gate, HTTP and HTML parsing, Playwright for dynamic sites, Scrapy, resilience.
